Resolution has about $61.57 left and Thirty about $61.12. Resolution should receive most of the remaining budget. Thirty still produces clicks but at a slightly higher cost.

Pausing Thirty would not free up its unspent budget to the other line item. Each campaign has a separate credit card cap, so the $450 limit is personal rather than shared.

The remaining budget can be reallocated across the three days at roughly $40.90 per day. I am calculating the exact microsecond spend for Resolution to set its new total budget precisely.

Exact microsecond calculations confirm the remaining budget is 122,689,567. Resolution’s new total budget will be 286,121,373 micro. Its daily cap for the final three days will be 40,896,522 micro. Thirty seconds will be paused to avoid competing for clicks.

The UK 18+ audience is large enough to absorb the higher daily spend. CPC may rise slightly, but the budget should still be fully allocated to the winning post.

The resolution line item will be updated to its new daily and total budgets, and the thirty seconds line item will be paused.
